scope: The selected 15-case, three-pass GoMarble Sonnet-high and Terra-high results reported on 8 September 2026. Costs cover selected executions, not the entire experiment history.
terraMethod: For each call: lower = ((input - cacheRead)*2.20 + cacheRead*0.22 + output*13.20)/1e6; upper = lower + (input - cacheRead)*0.55/1e6. Cache-write counts were not persisted. The endpoints bound zero versus all non-cache-read input being written to cache. Every recorded request was below 272K input tokens. Reasoning tokens are already included in output and are not added again.
